title: UBAG Worker Daemon Request Line (protocol v1 + opt-in v2)
description: One JSON object per line on the warm worker daemon's stdin (Go gateway to Python worker; see apps/worker/ubag_worker/live/daemon_protocol.py and apps/gateway/internal/executor/daemonrunner.go). Protocol v1 is the legacy {job_id, payload, deadline_s} line and stays valid unchanged. Protocol v2 is strictly opt-in: a sender asks for it by adding proto:2 to a job line or by sending a control line. Compatibility rules: (1) a v2 job line sent to a v1 daemon is safe, because v1 daemons read only job_id/payload/deadline_s and ignore the rest, so they answer with a v1 JOB_END; (2) a v1 job line sent to a v2 daemon MUST get a v1-shaped reply (no v2-only fields, no control lines); (3) control lines (hello, probe) MUST only be sent on explicit request, because a v1 daemon answers an unknown line with a failed JOB_END carrying an empty job_id and an unprompted control reply would corrupt a v1 reader; a sender treats that failed reply (or no reply within its handshake timeout) as 'daemon speaks v1'. The daemon never emits an unsolicited line outside a job or a control reply.

payload.description: The DispatchEnvelope (opaque to this schema; see the executor contract).

deadline_s.description: Hard per-job deadline in seconds enforced by the daemon.

proto.description: Opts this job into protocol v2 replies: the JOB_END echoes proto/attempt_id/slot_id and may carry pid, warm_key, outcome_signal, submitted, and status timed_out. Absent means v1.

attempt.description: Attempt identity for this run (ADR-0007). Only meaningful with proto:2. When present the daemon MUST stamp attempt_id into data of every event it emits and derive event_id from it (see job-event.schema.json), so a retried attempt's events never collide with an earlier attempt's.

lease_generation.description: Fencing generation of the attempt lease. Echoed by the daemon; the gateway rejects results carrying an older generation.

expires_at.description: Attempt lease expiry (informational for the daemon; it never extends the per-job deadline_s).

slot_id.description: Pool slot this daemon process serves (UBAG_WORKER_POOL_SIZE). Echoed in JOB_END; one daemon process is still one job at a time.

__ubag_control__.description: hello: negotiate the protocol version and learn capabilities. probe: read-only liveness/readiness query; MUST NOT touch the browser, type, or submit, and MUST NOT be sent while an operator login or viewer session is active.
